Package com.sbancuz.offscreen.integration.nei

@ParametersAreNonnullByDefault package com.sbancuz.offscreen.integration.nei
Optional HEI integration, retaining the upstream NEI package name.

A window-wide scope borrows shared ingredient/recipe/bookmark data but owns its overlay, search text, recipe navigation, input handler and listener registrations. A screen wrapper offers HEI input first, then forwards unconsumed actions to the underlying vanilla or ModularUI adapter. Load these classes only after confirming that HEI is available. Scoped operations run on the client thread.
